text:
kira: heads-up, canary for hera13b-int4 showing intermittent slab OOMs under mixed prompt load. observing 99p latency spikes when concurrent batch_count >= 4.
ashwin: paste the exact canary flags? particularly prefetch, batch_max, max_new_tokens, eviction.
kira: config:
```
model: hera13b-int4
batch_max: 8
batch_timeout_ms: 20
prefetch: true
max_new_tokens_default: 250
soft_eviction: false
kv_prefetch_slots: 30
```
marc: similar pattern to prior 13b runs — prefetch + long prompts tends to blow KV allocation, fragmentation shows up as free_fragments rising.
forge-bot: queued perf matrix -> batches (1,2,4), max_new (64,128,256), prefetch (on,off).
kira: quick matrix results: prefetch=on batch=4 max_new=256 -> OOM x3, 99p ~780ms. prefetch=off batch=4 max_new=256 -> OOM x1, 99p ~540ms. prefetch=off batch=2 max_new=128 -> no OOMs, 99p ~240ms.
ashwin: actionable: try safe defaults for canary: batch_max=4, batch_timeout_ms=15, prefetch=false, max_new_tokens_default=128, soft_eviction=true. pin to hera-canary pool.
kira: applied and deployed to pool-hera-canary (10 instances).
ops-bot: canary deploy started for hera13b-int4 -> pool-hera-canary.
forge-bot: running synthetic traffic (QPS 120) with 30% long prompts.
kira: after 50m: 0 OOMs, 99p=240-280ms, few tail spikes ~320ms.
marc: ablation: toggled soft_eviction=false -> reproduced 2 OOMs in 30m. re-enabled.
nashwin: file infra ticket for telemetry to detect sequential large-kv allocs per session (>3 in 2s) and auto-rollback threshold.
kira: INFRA-9021 opened. also adding onboarding note: "mixed-length models: default prefetch=false and conservative max_new until memory profile validated".
marc: run QA eval for quality impact from reducing max_new.
forge-bot: QA run: no meaningful metric regressions on canonical sets (delta <0.7%).
kira: summary: root cause = prefetched KV + large max_new + concurrent batches -> slab fragmentation -> sporadic OOMs. mitigations = conservative defaults (batch_timeout 15ms, prefetch=false, max_new_default 128, soft_eviction=true), telemetry, gradual rollout. plan: 24h clean canary then 50% pool roll.
nashwin: :+1: close when docs & infra ticket linked to model-onboard checklist.
